title: Agile Test Documentation: Test Cases, Bug Reports and Traceability
description:
Learn which testing documents help an Agile team: acceptance criteria, test cases, bug reports, exploratory charters and traceability. Follow a practical document example.

Try answering: What information would another tester need to reproduce your bug report?

Next lesson: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X0hokSm8f2U
Continue the course: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLXqX5lBoONpI
